references.label: Four top suit lanes
references.description: Top lanes that build the value of every standing card target.
references.context: The four top suit lanes raise standing drop-target values.

references.label: Center Queen target
references.description: Risky center card target that is safest when hit on an edge.
references.context: The center Queen can rebound toward the center drain.

references.label: Nine card targets
references.description: Standing card targets used to complete the displayed poker hand.
references.context: The nine card targets score their built value and advance hands.

references.label: Five Royal Flush targets
references.description: Jack-through-Ace targets used for the Royal Flush payoff.
references.context: The five Royal Flush targets collect Special or Wows by edition.

references.label: Side lanes
references.description: Outer lanes with copy-dependent exits that may respond to a late nudge.
references.context: The side lanes can return safely or feed a drain depending on the copy.

references.label: Open flipper guide
references.description: Wire guide whose outer gap can let a held ball roll into the outlane.
references.context: The open guide makes some held catches unsafe.
